title: Guidebooks that update themselves
summary: PDF Guidebooks get never read. Static PDFs age like milk—restaurants close, check‑in keypads change.
body_markdown:
## PDF Guidebooks get never read


**ProhostAI generates dynamic AI guest guidebooks from your listing details — check-in steps, Wi-Fi, house rules, and local tips — that stay current instead of going stale like a PDF. Guests open them from a link on any phone with no app to download, so they self-serve the basics and you field fewer repetitive messages.**


Static PDFs become outdated quickly, causing guest frustration and increasing message volume.


## Enter AI Guidebooks


ProhostAI creates dynamic guidebooks using AI that:


- Automatically populate content
- Provide mobile-optimized experience
- Support multiple languages


## Key modules


- **Arrival & parking** : Detailed instructions with photos and map links
- **House rules** : Auto-translated bullet lists
- **Local tips** : Nearby restaurants, groceries, emergency contacts


## Performance metrics


- 28% reduction in basic guest messages
- Five-star "Accuracy" ratings increased from 4.6 to 4.9
- Guidebook view tracking available


## Future features


- Fully automated guidebook generation
- Auto-updates with AI
- Upsells integration
- Guest self-service AI support
